import re

from .common import InfoExtractor
from ..utils import (
    fix_xml_all_ampersand,
    find_xpath_attr,
)


class ClipsyndicateIE(InfoExtractor):
    _VALID_URL = r'http://www\.clipsyndicate\.com/video/play(list/\d+)?/(?P<id>\d+)'

    _TEST = {
        u'url': u'http://www.clipsyndicate.com/video/play/4629301/brick_briscoe',
        u'md5': u'4d7d549451bad625e0ff3d7bd56d776c',
        u'info_dict': {
            u'id': u'4629301',
            u'ext': u'mp4',
            u'title': u'Brick Briscoe',
            u'duration': 612,
        },
    }

    def _real_extract(self, url):
        match = re.match(self._VALID_URL, url)
        vid_id = match.group('id')
        player_js = self._download_webpage(
            'http://eplayer.clipsyndicate.com/embed/player.js?va_id=%s' % vid_id,
            vid_id, u'Downlaoding player')
        # it includes a required token
        vars_str = self._search_regex(r'flvars: "(.*?)"', player_js, u'flvars')

        playlist_doc = self._download_xml(
            'http://eplayer.clipsyndicate.com/osmf/playlist?%s' % vars_str,
            vid_id, u'Downloading video info',
            transform_source=fix_xml_all_ampersand)

        track_node = playlist_doc.find('trackList/track')

        def get_param(param_name):
            elem = find_xpath_attr(track_node, './/param', 'name', param_name)
            if elem is not None:
                return elem.attrib['value']

        result = {}
        result['id'] = vid_id
        result['title'] = get_param('title')
        result['url'] = track_node.find('location').text
        result['thumbnail'] = get_param('thumbnail')
        result['duration'] = int(get_param('duration'))
        return result
